dataList.dlg: - *puff* Grab a glass, Lucio. - ... Am I to drink as well, Master? - You expect me to sit through watching these embarrassing losers and drink alone like some sad sack of shit, too?! - Humblest apologies, Master. Of course not. I'll be right back.

- Watching this battle has certainly been enlightening. - Enlightening...? What are you, fuckin' blind? You don't have shit to learn from these amateur-hour failures, Lucio. Or you wouldn't have, had you stuck to my instructions like I told you to. - ... Apologies, Master.
*scoff* What a bunch of fuck-ups. Had your unit been under my command, I would've had you all shot for poor performance! Get that?!

- Their injury seems quite severe, Master.
- Tell 'em to quit bitching. It's just a scratch—leave 'em be, and they'll be right as rain.
*sigh* Really? Can't even land the killing blow yourself? The quality of the Soldatos really went down the gutter in my absence, huh?
... Your form is broken.
Drive the arm straight through. Straight, goddammit! Ha, there you go. See? Nothing to it—you just need to do exactly as I taught you.
Pathetic weakling.

- More greenhorns who haven't had a taste of the War... Listen up. This is nothing compared to the kind of bullshit I saw during the War, got that? Get your shit together—this is your chance to score a big one and make a name! - You are admittedly on the back foot, but try to focus on handling them one at a time.

- *puff* This is boring as shit. *hic* You handle the rest, Lucio. Wake me up when they're done.
- ... Yes, Master.

- They managed to turn the tide of the battle, Master.
- Haha... I knew you fuck-ups weren't completely useless... Do I really have to bust your ass every time to get you into gear?

- Tsk, empty already?
- Allow me to bring you a refill, Master.
- Forget it. They're all fucked, anyway.

- See? If you're gonna start trouble like this, you better not show it on your face. You don't want to let your enemies catch on.
- I will take that lesson to heart, Master.
Haha, let's see what kinda fucked-up stunt we'll see this time.
Admirable precision.
Are they fuckin' slow or something?
Ha! Clever.

- Brainless fucks.
- Try to reidentify the prey's weak points.
So the vermin's finally hatching from its shell, is it?
Look at all that gunk the bugs have caked themselves with.
Kids these days have gone soft... They haven't got a shred of self-respect. Just look at them, waiting for handouts like this all day with no motivation to earn it themselves.

- *hic* Just what in hell did they get themselves smeared with? Fuckin' disgusting.
- This should put a damper on their movements.
Part dismantled.
That's right. Start with the arms and legs first when you're dismantling prey, or it'll forget its place and try to crawl away.
You fuck up, you get buried six feet under.

- Has my standing sunk so low that they expect me to sit through this amateur hour? Hahaha... Fuck it all.
- The mere display of this disgraceful performance is an affront to my master's honor.

- ...!
- What are you gaspin' for? Can’t fire off a round in any direction without hitting some random mongrel who can pull off this much.

- *puff* Yoshihide could do this shit with an arm tied behind her back at 14. Fourteen years old, your hear me? Tsk. More than I can say for a certain sorry excuse of a Textbook. Idiot. - My deepest apologies, Master. I will try my utmost to simulate her to the last— - Zip it. You're at least 10 years too early to be yapping about that.
... Yeah, just like how I used to move back in the day... Back when every last soul couldn't help but beg for Valencina of Famiglia Bognatelli to save the day... *puff*

- ... Well fought.
- The hunt comes to a close. I'm leavin' ahead—clear the fuck out on your own once you're done.

- Even in defeat, this experience will still serve as nourishment for growth.
- *puff* Nourishment my ass. More like a rank sack of shitty manure.

- Master, it's time to undertake the task requested by the Consigliere.
- Showing up after one million years just to dump this worthless busywork on us? Intolerable bastard. Tsk, Lucio! The usual.
- ... Old Parr served on the rocks. Right away, Master.
